description: Full un-cutoff relationship graph merged across all rows in run_phase5(), leaking future device and address sharing relationships into training features.
root_cause: Incomplete propagation of FIX-28; rel_graph_full with cutoff_date=None was merged directly onto df before splitting into train.
impact: Future device and address sharing events leaked into training samples for the hybrid GraphSAGE + XGBoost model, producing artificially inflated metrics.
fix: Implemented per-split relationship features using rel_graph_train (cutoff_date=TRAIN_END) for train_mask and rel_graph_val (cutoff_date=VAL_END) for val/test.
verification: CONFIRMED via automated regression test verifying that sharing events first observed after TRAIN_END yield share_degree=0 in training graph.

description: Production model training script constructed relationship graph without cutoff date before fitting combined_graph_model.joblib.
root_cause: Missing cutoff_date parameter in build_relationship_graph call prior to splitting train rows.
impact: Serialized production artifact combined_graph_model.joblib was fitted on training rows contaminated with future sharing relationships.
fix: Replaced global graph merge with per-split cutoff graphs (rel_graph_train with cutoff_date=TRAIN_END for train_mask and rel_graph_val for val/test).
verification: CONFIRMED via inspection and regression suite execution.

description: In Phase 5 scoring endpoint, prob (hybrid model score) was duplicated across both tabular_risk and gnn_risk slots.
root_cause: Development placeholder assigned the same hybrid prediction to both tabular and GNN component slots.
impact: Double-counted hybrid model probability giving it 55% effective weight; suppressed genuine model disagreement between tabular and GNN architectures.
fix: Queried store.combined_graph_model on tabular+graph columns to produce a distinct prob_tabular score, preserving GNN hybrid score in gnn_risk.
verification: CONFIRMED via live HTTP API smoke test and unit regression test.

description: Derived buyer_return_rate_before exceeded 1.0 when API clients supplied buyer_returns_before > buyer_orders_before.
root_cause: Missing upper-bound clipping during server-side ratio computation from raw counts.
impact: Out-of-distribution ratio values (> 1.0) passed to model feature vectors, inconsistent with training distributions.
fix: Clipped derived ratio using min(1.0, float(returns_before) / max(orders_before, 1)).
verification: CONFIRMED via unit test asserting derived rate is strictly <= 1.0.

description: Potential divide-by-zero produced inf or -inf when base_price was 0 or category median was 0.
root_cause: Direct division without replacing 0 denominators with NaN before fillna(0).
impact: np.inf values bypass fillna(0) and cause downstream scikit-learn / XGBoost training or inference failures.
fix: Replaced 0 with NaN in divisor series and explicitly replaced [np.inf, -np.inf] with NaN before filling 0.0.
verification: CONFIRMED via unit test evaluating DataFrame with base_price=0.0.

description: Documentation links in repository root README used ../docs/ instead of docs/, resulting in broken links.
root_cause: Path prefix copied from a subdirectory markdown file.
impact: 404 broken links when navigating documentation links from GitHub repository root.
fix: Updated all links to docs/... relative to repository root.

description: Inconsistent client behavior when supplying amount vs order_amount aliases.
root_cause: Two aliases without authoritative resolution or conflict detection.
impact: Silent discrepancies if conflicting values were supplied.
fix: Resolved via Pydantic v2 model_fields_set with strict 400 validation on conflicting values.

description: Stale CLIP embedding cache could be loaded even if underlying catalog product IDs changed.
root_cause: Absence of catalog content fingerprinting in cache header.
impact: Silent embedding index misalignment leading to invalid similarity scores.
fix: Added SHA256 catalog product fingerprinting to CLIPEmbeddingCache with automatic invalidation on mismatch.

description: Model output columns (e.g. trust_score, risk_score, decision) could inadvertently be fed back into training features.
root_cause: Omission of model-generated column names from banned list in leakage_audit.
impact: Self-referential feedback loops where models predict their own historical outputs.
fix: Added feedback loop guard banning all model-output columns in leakage_audit.

description: Phase 3 graph feature extraction previously used a single un-cutoff relationship graph across all orders.
root_cause: Single relationship graph constructed without cutoff_date parameter.
impact: Sharing edges established during validation or test periods leaked into training samples.
fix: Constructed rel_graph_train with cutoff_date=TRAIN_END and rel_graph_val with cutoff_date=VAL_END.

description: Returned type list[set[_Node]] failed static type check against declared return type List[Set[str]] in discover_candidate_communities.
root_cause: NetworkX stubs type connected_components nodes as generic hashable _Node, which is invariant with Set[str] in Python's type system.
impact: IDE and type checker flagged static type mismatch error; potential runtime type mismatch if non-string node identifiers entered the graph.
fix: Explicitly stringified node identifiers via comprehension {str(node) for node in c}, guaranteeing Set[str] outputs.
verification: CONFIRMED via inline unit test and full candidate community analysis execution.

description: Fallback imports from model_loader and schemas in except ImportError: block showed redlines (reportMissingImports) in IDE language server.
root_cause: backend directory was missing from extraPaths in pyrightconfig.json and .vscode/settings.json.
impact: IDE redlines for developers opening backend/main.py when workspace root is project root.
fix: Added backend to extraPaths in pyrightconfig.json and .vscode/settings.json, and added type: ignore[import-not-found] guards in backend/main.py.
verification: CONFIRMED via successful imports in both package execution mode and direct backend directory execution mode.
